description: Remove a guest from a trip, revoking their access and clearing their activity, lodging, and transportation assignments. Use the user id from collaborators. This may also revoke pending invitations for that user. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips. Destructive: this tool can remove or broadly mutate Tripsy data.

user_id.description: Guest user id from tripsy_collaborators_list, not a favorite record or invitation id.
